lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: Everybody!

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: Have you heard?
Heard what?
What's up?

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: Wouldn't you like to know?

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: Hehe, just kidding :D

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: You're gonna love this.

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: Since there's such a festive atmosphere outside,

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: I figured we ought to go on a little shopping spree together.

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: Wanna meet up at the boutique on Royal Road tomorrow?

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: :D

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Tomorrow?

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Let me think about it.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: My time is valuable.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Mine too.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: I know most people like to take it easy near the end of the year,

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: but any respectable boss always keeps their nose to the grindstone.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Those paychecks and annual bonuses aren't going to send themselves.
You guys are such spoilsports.
I just remembered that I'm busy tomorrow as well.

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: I should have known...

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: You too, Sweetie?

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: What's gotten into you guys? :'(

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: Why am I the one who always has to make plans?

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: It'd be nice if one of you asked to hang out once in a while!

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: Aren't we supposed to be a squad?

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: You've convinced me.

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: Huh, really???

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: I can join you guys if we go shopping online.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: We could also leave comments on your livestreams.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: That's kind of like us shopping together, isn't it? Close enough, at least.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: That way, we can be available even during meetings.
Do you need a link for the Shopaholics chatroom?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Eh, to be honest, I don't think that's a good idea.

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: Forget it!

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: All you two care about is money!

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: We can't do anything about it.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: How else could we buy your fancy new winter-wear?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Not to mention all those designer bags.

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Exactly what I said.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: We went out and ordered

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: some designer bags and winter wear for you.

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: What are we gonna do, Sweetie?

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: We don't deserve to be in the company

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: of such distinguished young ladies.

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: That's it. I'm renaming the group to:

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: ☆ The Distinguished Debutantes and their Devout Devotees ☆

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: I'll take that as a sign that you're pleased?

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: Of course!!! I'm tearing up over here!

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: In that case, how about sending 50 samples of your new product to Talentum Mall?

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: You got it!

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: I'll get on it right away.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Just a friendly reminder,

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: we'll be releasing a new laptop model soon.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: We'd love to partner up with your brand of laptop bags.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: What do you say?

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: Let's do it! After all, isn't that what a devotee is for? :D

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: Do you want a custom design? Name it, and we'll make it happen.
This conversation seems to have taken a turn...
Was this all a setup?

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Client,

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: you're harshing our vibe.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: I think we'd have enough fun with Rupee anyway.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Shall we call it a day?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: I've got a meeting coming up.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Same here.

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: Wishing great fortune to our

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: fabulous Talentum debutantes!

lines.speaker: rupee_w
lines.text: Bye!
